/.seo_title: Smartwatch Solutions | Fleet & Cargo Tracking in East Africa
/.seo_desc: Fleet management, electronic cargo tracking and telematics for East Africa since 2011. KRA-approved vendor for EAC RECTS, serving Uganda and Kenya.

/solutions.seo_title: Fleet Solutions by Industry | Smartwatch Solutions
/solutions.seo_desc: Telematics solutions for transport, oil and gas, cargo, public transport, government, NGOs, field service and more across East Africa.

/products/driver-safety-dash-cameras.seo_title: Driver Safety Dash Cameras | Smartwatch Solutions
/products/driver-safety-dash-cameras.seo_desc: Proactively manage fleet safety, deliver documented results, and free up more time in your day.

/products/tracking-and-telematics.seo_desc: Live visibility into your operational health, utilization, location, equipment, and assets.

/products/maintenance.seo_desc: Reduce downtime, maximize productivity and reduce costs with preventive fleet maintenance.

/solutions/oil-and-gas.seo_desc: Transform oil & gas operations through AI-powered automation that improves driver safety, asset tracking, cost control, and compliance management.

/solutions/electronic-cargo-tracking.seo_desc: A heavy-duty electromagnetic lock integrated with commercial vehicle operation services to automate cargo, security, carrier and support operations.

/solutions/bus-and-public-transport.seo_desc: Real-time bus tracking, driver behaviour monitoring, multi-channel video surveillance and high-accuracy people counting for bus and coach fleets.

/solutions/communications-technology.seo_desc: Smartwatch FM helps our clients manage their assets remotely – improving fleet operational efficiency and productivity while reducing transportation costs.

/solutions/government.seo_title: Fleet Management for Government | Smartwatch Solutions
/solutions/government.seo_desc: With our telematics technology at your disposal, you can stay within strict budget requirements, track utilisation, meet green goals and manage vehicles.

/solutions/food-manufacturing.seo_desc: Moving the world forward by connecting & protecting fleet operations with solutions that achieve safety, sustainability, compliance and efficiency.

/solutions/field-service.seo_desc: Automate field service operations to increase team productivity, reduce expenses and refine customer experience.

/solutions/ngo-satellite-tracking.seo_title: Satellite Tracking for NGOs | Smartwatch Solutions
/solutions/ngo-satellite-tracking.seo_desc: Identify where your vehicles are at all times, determine wasteful or unsafe driving, better manage routes and raise red flags on mechanical problems.

/solutions/trucking-and-logistics.seo_desc: Total visibility into every aspect of fleet management from safety and tracking to compliance and fuel costs.

/solutions/eco-drive.seo_desc: Monitor driving risk, compare driver performance to spot improvements, and collect data from all vehicle brands.

/solutions/commercial-vehicle-tracking.seo_desc: An easy-to-use, safe and reliable tracking solution for light commercial vehicles that reads manufacturer-specific CANbus data via the OBDII port.

/solutions/ev-fleet-management.seo_desc: An advanced charging module with state-of-charge overview, cost analysis and optimization, and real-time notifications and alerts.

/solutions/site-management.seo_desc: Site Management gives you overarching visibility of every one of your sites and remote assets, including their performance and any potential malfunctions.
